program.section_heading: Fermentation Management - Associate of Science Degree: Mesa
outcomes: Emphasize a broad foundation in fermentation management and practice.
Prepare students for all stages of fermentation management and how it relates to production, operations, finance, hiring, retail, sales, marketing, laws, and regulations.
Provide students with an understanding of the fermentation process, timeline, and ideal environment for the process to take place.
Produce quality fermented beverages safely utilizing equipment comparable to beverage manufacturing operations. (Fermentation Management AS only)
